crew.original_title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
crew.overview: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.
crew.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

crew.overview: Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.
crew.title: Pacific Rim

crew.overview: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.
crew.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron

crew.original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
crew.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
crew.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

crew.overview: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.
crew.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home

crew.overview: An FBI agent and an Interpol detective track a team of illusionists who pull off bank heists during their performances and reward their audiences with the money.
crew.title: Now You See Me

crew.overview: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!
crew.title: The Avengers

details.biography:
Chris Lentz is an animation supervisor at DNEG. Originally from Washington, D.C., he studied at the Rhode Island School of Design, earning a Bachelor of Fine Arts in Painting, and later completed a Master of Fine Arts in Character Animation at the University of the Arts. Alongside his professional career, he continued to pursue personal artistic interests in photography and sculpture.

Lentz began his career working on major feature films, including X-Men (2000), The Matrix Reloaded (2003), and The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005). His work gained particular recognition with Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part II (2011), where he contributed to the animation of the Gringotts Dragon. This earned him and his team a nomination at the Visual Effects Society Awards in 2012 for Outstanding Animated Character in a Live Action Feature Motion Picture.

From 2012 to 2014, Lentz worked at Industrial Light & Magic’s Singapore studio, where he started as Lead Animator on The Avengers (2012). In 2016, he joined ILM’s London studio as an Animation Supervisor, contributing to films such as Pacific Rim (2013), Star Trek Into Darkness (2013), Godzilla (2014), Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (2016), Transformers: The Last Knight (2017), and Solo: A Star Wars Story (2018). For his work on Pacific Rim, he and his colleagues received the Hollywood Post Alliance Award in 2013 for Outstanding Visual Effects – Feature Film, and in 2014, he was nominated for the Annie Award for Outstanding Achievement in Character Animation in a Live Action Production.

In 2022, Lentz joined DNEG’s London studio as Animation Supervisor and supervised Venom: The Last Dance (2024).
details.name: Chris Lentz
